        "-class DataSplitterStep(Step):",
        "-    """Split data into train/validation/test sets.",
        "-    ",
        "-    Supports stratified splits, time-based splits, and cross-validation.",
        "-    """",
        "-    ",
        "-    def __init__(",
        "-        self,",
        "-        train_size: float = 0.7,",
        "-        val_size: float = 0.15,",
        "-        test_size: float = 0.15,",
        "-        random_state: int = 42,",
        "-        stratify: bool = True,",
        "-        shuffle: bool = True,",
        "-        time_column: Optional[str] = None,",
        "-        cv_folds: Optional[int] = None,",
        "-        cv_strategy: str = "kfold",",
        "-    ):",
        "-        self.train_size = train_size",
        "-        self.val_size = val_size",
        "-        self.test_size = test_size",
        "-        self.random_state = random_state",
        "-        self.stratify = stratify",
        "-        self.shuffle = shuffle",
        "-        self.time_column = time_column",
        "-        self.cv_folds = cv_folds",
        "-        self.cv_strategy = cv_strategy",
        "-        self.splits = {}",
        "-    ",
        "-    def execute(",
        "-        self,",
        "-        data: Union[pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray],",
        "-        target: Optional[Union[pd.Series, np.ndarray]] = None,",
        "-        context: Dict[str, Any] = None",
        "-    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:",
        "-        ",
        "-        context = context or {}",
        "-        is_df = isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame)",
        "-        ",
        "-        # Handle time-based split",
        "-        if self.time_column:",
        "-            if not is_df:",
        "-                raise ValueError("Time-based split requires DataFrame")",
        "-            data = data.sort_values(self.time_column)",
        "-            n = len(data)",
        "-            train_end = int(n * self.train_size)",
        "-            val_end = train_end + int(n * self.val_size)",
        "-            ",
        "-            train_data = data.iloc[:train_end]",
        "-            val_data = data.iloc[train_end:val_end]",
        "-            test_data = data.iloc[val_end:]",
        "-            ",
        "-        elif self.cv_folds:",
        "-            # Cross-validation splits",
        "-            if self.cv_strategy == "stratified" and target is not None:",
        "-                splitter = StratifiedKFold(",
        "-                    n_splits=self.cv_folds,",
        "-                    shuffle=self.shuffle,",
        "-                    random_state=self.random_state",
        "-                )",
        "-            else:",
        "-                splitter = KFold(",
        "-                    n_splits=self.cv_folds,",
        "-                    shuffle=self.shuffle,",
        "-                    random_state=self.random_state",
        "-                )",
        "-            ",
        "-            splits = []",
        "-            for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(splitter.split(data, target)):",
        "-                splits.append({",
        "-                    "fold": fold_idx,",
        "-                    "train_idx": train_idx,",
        "-                    "val_idx": val_idx,",
        "-                })",
        "-            ",
        "-            context["cv_splits"] = splits",
        "-            return splits",
        "-        ",
        "-        else:",
        "-            # Standard train/val/test split",
        "-            stratify_param = target if (self.stratify and target is not None) else None",
        "-            ",
        "-            # First split: train vs remaining",
        "-            train_data, remaining_data, train_target, remaining_target = train_test_split(",
        "-                data, target,",
        "-                train_size=self.train_size,",
        "-                random_state=self.random_state,",
        "-                shuffle=self.shuffle,",
        "-                stratify=stratify_param",
        "-            )",
        "-            ",
        "-            # Second split: val vs test",
        "-            val_ratio = self.val_size / (self.val_size + self.test_size)",
        "-            val_target = remaining_target",
        "-            ",
        "-            if stratify_param is not None:",
        "-                val_stratify = remaining_target",
        "-            else:",
        "-                val_stratify = None",
        "-            ",
        "-            val_data, test_data, val_target, test_target = train_test_split(",
        "-                remaining_data, remaining_target,",
        "-                train_size=val_ratio,",
        "-                random_state=self.random_state,",
        "-                shuffle=self.shuffle,",
        "-                stratify=val_stratify",
        "-            )",
        "-        ",
        "-        result = {",
        "-            "train": train_data,",
        "-            "val": val_data,",
        "-            "test": test_data,",
        "-        }",
        "-        ",
        "-        if target is not None:",
        "-            result["train_target"] = train_target",
        "-            result["val_target"] = val_target",
        "-            result["test_target"] = test_target if not self.time_column else remaining_target",
        "-        ",
        "-        context["split_info"] = {",
        "-            "train_size": len(train_data),",
        "-            "val_size": len(val_data),",
        "-            "test_size": len(test_data),",
        "-            "stratify": self.stratify,",
        "-            "time_based": self.time_column is not None,",
        "-        }",
        "-        ",
        "-        return result",
        "+"""AutoPipe Data Processing Steps.",
        "+",
        "+Comprehensive data pipeline steps for ML/DL workflows:",
        "+- Data loading (CSV, Parquet, JSON, SQL, cloud storage)",
        "+- Data validation (schema, nulls, outliers, duplicates)",
        "+- Data preprocessing (scaling, encoding, imputation)",
        "+- Feature selection (KBest, model-based, RFE)",
        "+- Data splitting (train/val/test, stratified, time-based)",
        "+"""",
        "+",
        "+from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Union, Tuple",
        "+import numpy as np",
        "+import pandas as pd",
        "+from dataclasses import dataclass, field",
        "+",
        "+from autopipe.core.step import Step",
        "+",
        "+",
        "+@dataclass",
        "+class ValidationReport:",
        "+    """Comprehensive data validation report."""",
        "+    is_valid: bool = True",
        "+    missing_columns: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)",
        "+    null_counts: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)",
        "+    null_percentages: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)",
        "+    duplicate_count: int = 0",
        "+    outliers_detected: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)",
        "+    type_violations: Dict[str, List[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)",
        "+    value_violations: Dict[str, List[Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)",
        "+    warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)",
        "+    errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)",
        "+",
        "+",
        "+class DataLoaderStep(Step):",
        "+    """Load data from various sources.",
        "+    ",
        "+    Supports CSV, Parquet, JSON, SQL databases, and cloud storage.",
        "+    """",
        "+    ",
        "+    def __init__(",
        "+        self,",
        "+        name: str = "data_loader",",
        "+        source: str = None,",
        "+        format: str = "csv",",
        "+        sql_connection: Optional[str] = None,",
        "+        sql_query: Optional[str] = None,",
        "+        options: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,",
        "+        **kwargs",
        "+    ):",
        "+        super().__init__(name, **kwargs)",
        "+        self.source = source",
        "+        self.format = format.lower()",
        "+        self.sql_connection = sql_connection",
        "+        self.sql_query = sql_query",
        "+        self.options = options or {}",
        "+        ",
        "+    def run(self, **kwargs) -> pd.DataFrame:",
        "+        """Load data from specified source."""",
        "+        import logging",
        "+        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Get source from kwargs if not set",
        "+        source = self.source or kwargs.get('source')",
        "+        ",
        "+        if not source and not self.sql_query:",
        "+            raise ValueError("Data source must be specified")",
        "+        ",
        "+        logger.info(f"Loading data from {source} (format: {self.format})")",
        "+        ",
        "+        if self.format == "csv":",
        "+            df = pd.read_csv(source, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "parquet":",
        "+            df = pd.read_parquet(source, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "json":",
        "+            df = pd.read_json(source, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "excel" or self.format == "xlsx":",
        "+            df = pd.read_excel(source, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "sql":",
        "+            import sqlalchemy",
        "+            engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine(self.sql_connection)",
        "+            df = pd.read_sql(self.sql_query, engine, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "feather":",
        "+            df = pd.read_feather(source, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "hdf5" or self.format == "h5":",
        "+            df = pd.read_hdf(source, **self.options)",
        "+        elif self.format == "pickle" or self.format == "pkl":",
        "+            df = pd.read_pickle(source, **self.options)",
        "+        else:",
        "+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported format: {self.format}")",
        "+        ",
        "+        self.log_metrics(",
        "+            rows_loaded=len(df),",
        "+            columns_loaded=len(df.columns),",
        "+            memory_usage_mb=df.memory_usage(deep=True).sum() / 1024 / 1024",
        "+        )",
        "+        ",
        "+        logger.info(f"Loaded {len(df)} rows and {len(df.columns)} columns")",
        "+        return df",
        "+    ",
        "+    def visualize(self, **kwargs):",
        "+        """Generate data loading visualization."""",
        "+        from autopipe.visualization import ChartGenerator",
        "+        chart = ChartGenerator()",
        "+        ",
        "+        if self.metrics:",
        "+            chart.plot_metrics(",
        "+                {k: [v] for k, v in self.metrics.items() if isinstance(v, (int, float))},",
        "+                title=f"Data Loading Metrics - {self.name}"",
        "+            )",
        "+",
        "+",
        "+class DataValidatorStep(Step):",
        "+    """Comprehensive data validation step.",
        "+    ",
        "+    Validates data schema, nulls, duplicates, outliers, and data types.",
        "+    """",
        "+    ",
        "+    def __init__(",
        "+        self,",
        "+        name: str = "data_validator",",
        "+        required_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,",
        "+        column_types: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,",
        "+        max_null_ratio: float = 0.5,",
        "+        check_duplicates: bool = True,",
        "+        check_outliers: bool = True,",
        "+        outlier_method: str = "iqr",",
        "+        outlier_threshold: float = 1.5,",
        "+        value_ranges: Optional[Dict[str, Tuple]] = None,",
        "+        **kwargs",
        "+    ):",
        "+        super().__init__(name, **kwargs)",
        "+        self.required_columns = required_columns or []",
        "+        self.column_types = column_types or {}",
        "+        self.max_null_ratio = max_null_ratio",
        "+        self.check_duplicates = check_duplicates",
        "+        self.check_outliers = check_outliers",
        "+        self.outlier_method = outlier_method",
        "+        self.outlier_threshold = outlier_threshold",
        "+        self.value_ranges = value_ranges or {}",
        "+        self.validation_report: Optional[ValidationReport] = None",
        "+        ",
        "+    def run(self, **kwargs) -> pd.DataFrame:",
        "+        """Validate input data and return cleaned DataFrame."""",
        "+        import logging",
        "+        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Get DataFrame from inputs",
        "+        df = None",
        "+        for key, value in kwargs.items():",
        "+            if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):",
        "+                df = value.copy()",
        "+                break",
        "+        ",
        "+        if df is None:",
        "+            raise ValueError("DataValidatorStep requires a DataFrame input")",
        "+        ",
        "+        logger.info(f"Validating data with {len(df)} rows and {len(df.columns)} columns")",
        "+        ",
        "+        report = ValidationReport()",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Check required columns",
        "+        missing_cols = [col for col in self.required_columns if col not in df.columns]",
        "+        if missing_cols:",
        "+            report.is_valid = False",
        "+            report.missing_columns = missing_cols",
        "+            report.errors.append(f"Missing required columns: {missing_cols}")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Check null ratios",
        "+        null_counts = df.isnull().sum()",
        "+        null_percentages = (df.isnull().sum() / len(df) * 100).to_dict()",
        "+        report.null_counts = null_counts.to_dict()",
        "+        report.null_percentages = null_percentages",
        "+        ",
        "+        high_null_cols = [col for col, pct in null_percentages.items() ",
        "+                         if pct > self.max_null_ratio * 100]",
        "+        if high_null_cols:",
        "+            report.warnings.append(f"High null ratio in columns: {high_null_cols}")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Check duplicates",
        "+        if self.check_duplicates:",
        "+            dup_count = df.duplicated().sum()",
        "+            report.duplicate_count = dup_count",
        "+            if dup_count > 0:",
        "+                report.warnings.append(f"Found {dup_count} duplicate rows")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Check outliers",
        "+        if self.check_outliers:",
        "+            outliers = self._detect_outliers(df)",
        "+            report.outliers_detected = outliers",
        "+            for col, count in outliers.items():",
        "+                if count > 0:",
        "+                    report.warnings.append(f"Detected {count} outliers in {col}")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Check value ranges",
        "+        for col, (min_val, max_val) in self.value_ranges.items():",
        "+            if col in df.columns:",
        "+                violations = df[(df[col] < min_val) | (df[col] > max_val)]",
        "+                if len(violations) > 0:",
        "+                    report.value_violations[col] = violations[col].tolist()[:10]  # First 10",
        "+                    report.warnings.append(f"{col} has {len(violations)} values outside range")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Type checks",
        "+        for col, expected_type in self.column_types.items():",
        "+            if col in df.columns:",
        "+                actual_type = str(df[col].dtype)",
        "+                # Simple type checking",
        "+                if expected_type == "numeric" and not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):",
        "+                    report.type_violations[col] = [f"Expected numeric, got {actual_type}"]",
        "+                elif expected_type == "categorical" and not pd.api.types.is_categorical_dtype(df[col]):",
        "+                    if not pd.api.types.is_object_dtype(df[col]):",
        "+                        report.type_violations[col] = [f"Expected categorical, got {actual_type}"]",
        "+        ",
        "+        self.validation_report = report",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Log results",
        "+        self.log_metrics(",
        "+            is_valid=int(report.is_valid),",
        "+            missing_columns=len(report.missing_columns),",
        "+            duplicate_count=report.duplicate_count,",
        "+            total_outliers=sum(report.outliers_detected.values()),",
        "+            warnings=len(report.warnings),",
        "+            errors=len(report.errors)",
        "+        )",
        "+        ",
        "+        logger.info(f"Validation complete: valid={report.is_valid}, errors={len(report.errors)}, warnings={len(report.warnings)}")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Add validation context",
        "+        if 'context' in kwargs:",
        "+            kwargs['context']['validation_results'] = report",
        "+        ",
        "+        return df",
        "+    ",
        "+    def _detect_outliers(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, int]:",
        "+        """Detect outliers using IQR or Z-score method."""",
        "+        outliers = {}",
        "+        numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns",
        "+        ",
        "+        for col in numeric_cols:",
        "+            if self.outlier_method == "iqr":",
        "+                Q1 = df[col].quantile(0.25)",
        "+                Q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)",
        "+                IQR = Q3 - Q1",
        "+                lower_bound = Q1 - self.outlier_threshold * IQR",
        "+                upper_bound = Q3 + self.outlier_threshold * IQR",
        "+                outlier_count = ((df[col] < lower_bound) | (df[col] > upper_bound)).sum()",
        "+            elif self.outlier_method == "zscore":",
        "+                z_scores = np.abs((df[col] - df[col].mean()) / df[col].std())",
        "+                outlier_count = (z_scores > self.outlier_threshold).sum()",
        "+            else:",
        "+                outlier_count = 0",
        "+            ",
        "+            outliers[col] = int(outlier_count)",
        "+        ",
        "+        return outliers",
        "+    ",
        "+    def visualize(self, **kwargs):",
        "+        """Generate validation report visualization."""",
        "+        from autopipe.visualization import ChartGenerator",
        "+        chart = ChartGenerator()",
        "+        ",
        "+        if self.validation_report:",
        "+            metrics = {",
        "+                "Validity": [int(self.validation_report.is_valid)],",
        "+                "Missing Columns": [len(self.validation_report.missing_columns)],",
        "+                "Duplicates": [self.validation_report.duplicate_count],",
        "+                "Warnings": [len(self.validation_report.warnings)],",
        "+                "Errors": [len(self.validation_report.errors)]",
        "+            }",
        "+            chart.plot_metrics(metrics, title=f"Validation Summary - {self.name}")",
        "+",
        "+",
        "+class DataPreprocessorStep(Step):",
        "+    """Comprehensive data preprocessing step.",
        "+    ",
        "+    Handles scaling, encoding, and imputation with proper fit/transform separation.",
        "+    """",
        "+    ",
        "+    def __init__(",
        "+        self,",
        "+        name: str = "data_preprocessor",",
        "+        numeric_scaling: Optional[str] = "standard",",
        "+        categorical_encoding: Optional[str] = "onehot",",
        "+        imputation_strategy: str = "mean",",
        "+        imputation_numeric: Optional[str] = None,",
        "+        imputation_categorical: Optional[str] = None,",
        "+        handle_unknown: str = "ignore",",
        "+        passthrough_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,",
        "+        **kwargs",
        "+    ):",
        "+        super().__init__(name, **kwargs)",
        "+        self.numeric_scaling = numeric_scaling",
        "+        self.categorical_encoding = categorical_encoding",
        "+        self.imputation_strategy = imputation_strategy",
        "+        self.imputation_numeric = imputation_numeric or imputation_strategy",
        "+        self.imputation_categorical = imputation_categorical or "most_frequent"",
        "+        self.handle_unknown = handle_unknown",
        "+        self.passthrough_columns = passthrough_columns or []",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Fitted transformers storage",
        "+        self._scaler = None",
        "+        self._encoders: Dict[str, Any] = {}",
        "+        self._imputer_numeric = None",
        "+        self._imputer_categorical = None",
        "+        self._feature_names: List[str] = []",
        "+        ",
        "+    def run(self, **kwargs) -> pd.DataFrame:",
        "+        """Preprocess data with scaling, encoding, and imputation."""",
        "+        import logging",
        "+        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)",
        "+        ",
        "+        df = None",
        "+        for key, value in kwargs.items():",
        "+            if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):",
        "+                df = value.copy()",
        "+                break",
        "+        ",
        "+        if df is None:",
        "+            raise ValueError("DataPreprocessorStep requires a DataFrame input")",
        "+        ",
        "+        logger.info(f"Preprocessing data with {len(df)} rows")",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Separate columns",
        "+        numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()",
        "+        categorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns.tolist()",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Remove passthrough columns",
        "+        numeric_cols = [c for c in numeric_cols if c not in self.passthrough_columns]",
        "+        categorical_cols = [c for c in categorical_cols if c not in self.passthrough_columns]",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Imputation",
        "+        df = self._apply_imputation(df, numeric_cols, categorical_cols)",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Scaling",
        "+        if self.numeric_scaling and numeric_cols:",
        "+            df = self._apply_scaling(df, numeric_cols)",
        "+        ",
        "+        # Encoding",
        "+        if self.categorical_encoding and categorical_cols:",
        "+            df = self._apply_encoding(df, categorical_cols)",
        "+        ",
        "+        self.log_metrics(",
        "+            original_columns=len(df.columns),",
        "+            numeric_scaled=len(numeric_cols),",
        "+            categorical_encoded=len(categorical_cols),",
        "+            final_columns=len(df.columns)",
        "+        )",
        "+        ",
        "+        logger.info(f"Preprocessing complete: {len(df.columns)} columns")",

This module provides comprehensive data processing, transformation,

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union, Callable
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import (

class DataLoaderStep(Step):
    """Load data from various sources.
    
    Supports CSV, Parquet, JSON, SQL databases, cloud storage (S3, GCS, Azure),
    and streaming sources.
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        source: str,
        format: str = "csv",
        batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
        chunk_size: Optional[int] = None,
        cache: bool = True,
        **kwargs
    ):
        self.source = source
        self.format = format.lower()
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.cache = cache
        self.kwargs = kwargs
        self._cache = None
    
    def _load_csv(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if self.batch_size:
            return pd.read_csv(
                self.source,
                chunksize=self.batch_size,
                **self.kwargs
            )
        return pd.read_csv(self.source, **self.kwargs)
    
    def _load_parquet(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return pd.read_parquet(self.source, **self.kwargs)
    
    def _load_json(self) -> Union[pd.DataFrame, Dict]:
        return pd.read_json(self.source, **self.kwargs)
    
    def _load_sql(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        import sqlalchemy
        engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine(self.source)
        query = self.kwargs.get("query", "SELECT * FROM table")
        return pd.read_sql(query, engine, **self.kwargs)
    
    def execute(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        if self.cache and self._cache is not None:
            return self._cache
        
        loaders = {
            "csv": self._load_csv,
            "parquet": self._load_parquet,
            "json": self._load_json,
            "sql": self._load_sql,
        }
        
        if self.format not in loaders:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported format: {self.format}")
        
        data = loaders[self.format]()
        
        if self.cache:
            self._cache = data
        
        context["data_loaded"] = True
        context["data_shape"] = data.shape if hasattr(data, "shape") else None
        return data


class DataValidatorStep(Step):
    """Validate data quality and schema.
    
    Performs comprehensive data validation including:
    - Schema validation (column types, missing values)
    - Data quality checks (duplicates, outliers, distributions)
    - Statistical validation (mean, std, skewness)
    - Custom validation rules
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        schema: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        required_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        max_null_ratio: float = 0.5,
        check_duplicates: bool = True,
        check_outliers: bool = True,
        outlier_method: str = "iqr",
        outlier_threshold: float = 1.5,
        custom_validations: Optional[List[Callable]] = None,
    ):
        self.schema = schema
        self.required_columns = required_columns or []
        self.max_null_ratio = max_null_ratio
        self.check_duplicates = check_duplicates
        self.check_outliers = check_outliers
        self.outlier_method = outlier_method
        self.outlier_threshold = outlier_threshold
        self.custom_validations = custom_validations or []
        self.validation_results = {}
    
    def _detect_outliers_iqr(self, data: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        Q1 = data.quantile(0.25)
        Q3 = data.quantile(0.75)
        IQR = Q3 - Q1
        return (data < (Q1 - self.outlier_threshold * IQR)) | (data > (Q3 + self.outlier_threshold * IQR))
    
    def _detect_outliers_zscore(self, data: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        z_scores = np.abs((data - data.mean()) / data.std())
        return z_scores > self.outlier_threshold
    
    def execute(self, data: pd.DataFrame, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        validation_passed = True
        issues = []
        
        # Check required columns
        if self.required_columns:
            missing = set(self.required_columns) - set(data.columns)
            if missing:
                validation_passed = False
                issues.append(f"Missing required columns: {missing}")
        
        # Check null ratios
        null_ratios = data.isnull().mean()
        high_nulls = null_ratios[null_ratios > self.max_null_ratio]
        if not high_nulls.empty:
            issues.append(f"High null ratio in columns: {high_nulls.to_dict()}")
        
        # Check duplicates
        if self.check_duplicates:
            duplicates = data.duplicated().sum()
            if duplicates > 0:
                issues.append(f"Found {duplicates} duplicate rows")
                data = data.drop_duplicates()
        
        # Check outliers
        if self.check_outliers:
            numeric_cols = data.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
            outlier_counts = {}
            for col in numeric_cols:
                if self.outlier_method == "iqr":
                    outliers = self._detect_outliers_iqr(data[col]).sum()
                else:
                    outliers = self._detect_outliers_zscore(data[col]).sum()
                if outliers > 0:
                    outlier_counts[col] = int(outliers)
            if outlier_counts:
                issues.append(f"Outliers detected: {outlier_counts}")
        
        # Run custom validations
        for validator in self.custom_validations:
            try:
                validator(data)
            except Exception as e:
                validation_passed = False
                issues.append(f"Custom validation failed: {str(e)}")
        
        self.validation_results = {
            "passed": validation_passed,
            "issues": issues,
            "shape": data.shape,
            "null_ratios": null_ratios.to_dict(),
            "duplicate_count": duplicates if self.check_duplicates else 0,
            "outlier_counts": outlier_counts if self.check_outliers else {},
        }
        
        context["validation_results"] = self.validation_results
        
        if not validation_passed and issues:
            raise ValueError(f"Data validation failed: {'; '.join(issues)}")
        
        return data


class FeatureEngineeringStep(Step):
    """Advanced feature engineering for ML/DL.
    
    Supports:
    - Polynomial features
    - Interaction features
    - Binning/discretization
    - Date/time features
    - Text features (TF-IDF, embeddings)
    - Domain-specific features
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        polynomial_degree: int = 2,
        interaction_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        binning_columns: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
        datetime_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        text_columns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        text_mode: str = "tfidf",
        lag_features: Optional[Dict[str, List[int]]] = None,
        rolling_windows: Optional[Dict[str, List[int]]] = None,
    ):
        self.polynomial_degree = polynomial_degree
        self.interaction_columns = interaction_columns or []
        self.binning_columns = binning_columns or {}
        self.datetime_columns = datetime_columns or []
        self.text_columns = text_columns or []
        self.text_mode = text_mode
        self.lag_features = lag_features or {}
        self.rolling_windows = rolling_windows or {}
        self.encoders = {}
    
    def _extract_datetime_features(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        for col in self.datetime_columns:
            if col in data.columns:
                dt = pd.to_datetime(data[col])
                data[f"{col}_year"] = dt.dt.year
                data[f"{col}_month"] = dt.dt.month
                data[f"{col}_day"] = dt.dt.day
                data[f"{col}_dayofweek"] = dt.dt.dayofweek
                data[f"{col}_hour"] = dt.dt.hour
                data[f"{col}_is_weekend"] = (dt.dt.dayofweek >= 5).astype(int)
                data[f"{col}_quarter"] = dt.dt.quarter
        return data
    
    def _extract_text_features(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
        
        for col in self.text_columns:
            if col not in data.columns:
                continue
            
            # Fill NaN values
            text_data = data[col].fillna("")
            
            if self.text_mode == "tfidf":
                vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=100, stop_words="english")
            else:
                vectorizer = CountVectorizer(max_features=100, stop_words="english")
            
            vectors = vectorizer.fit_transform(text_data)
            feature_names = [f"{col}_tfidf_{i}" for i in range(vectors.shape[1])]
            
            for i, name in enumerate(feature_names):
                data[name] = vectors[:, i].toarray().flatten()
            
            self.encoders[col] = vectorizer
        
        return data
    
    def _create_interaction_features(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
        
        if not self.interaction_columns:
            return data
        
        numeric_cols = data[self.interaction_columns].select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
        if numeric_cols.empty:
            return data
        
        poly = PolynomialFeatures(
            degree=self.polynomial_degree,
            interaction_only=True,
            include_bias=False
        )
        features = poly.fit_transform(numeric_cols)
        
        feature_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(numeric_cols.columns)
        for i, name in enumerate(feature_names):
            if name not in numeric_cols.columns:
                data[f"poly_{name}"] = features[:, i]
        
        return data
    
    def _create_lag_features(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        for col, lags in self.lag_features.items():
            if col not in data.columns:
                continue
            for lag in lags:
                data[f"{col}_lag_{lag}"] = data[col].shift(lag)
        return data
    
    def _create_rolling_features(self, data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        for col, windows in self.rolling_windows.items():
            if col not in data.columns:
                continue
            for window in windows:
                data[f"{col}_rolling_mean_{window}"] = data[col].rolling(window=window).mean()
                data[f"{col}_rolling_std_{window}"] = data[col].rolling(window=window).std()
        return data
    
    def execute(self, data: pd.DataFrame, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        initial_shape = data.shape
        
        # DateTime features
        data = self._extract_datetime_features(data)
        
        # Text features
        if self.text_columns:
            data = self._extract_text_features(data)
        
        # Interaction features
        data = self._create_interaction_features(data)
        
        # Lag features
        data = self._create_lag_features(data)
        
        # Rolling features
        data = self._create_rolling_features(data)
        
        final_shape = data.shape
        
        context["feature_engineering"] = {
            "initial_features": initial_shape[1],
            "final_features": final_shape[1],
            "new_features_created": final_shape[1] - initial_shape[1],
        }
        
        return data


class DataPreprocessorStep(Step):
    """Comprehensive data preprocessing pipeline.
    
    Supports scaling, encoding, imputation, and custom transformations.
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        numeric_scaling: str = "standard",
        categorical_encoding: str = "onehot",
        imputation_strategy: str = "mean",
        imputation_neighbors: int = 5,
        scale_categories: bool = False,
        handle_unknown: str = "ignore",
    ):
        self.numeric_scaling = numeric_scaling
        self.categorical_encoding = categorical_encoding
        self.imputation_strategy = imputation_strategy
        self.imputation_neighbors = imputation_neighbors
        self.scale_categories = scale_categories
        self.handle_unknown = handle_unknown
        self.transformers = {}
        self.feature_names = {}
    
    def _get_scaler(self):
        scalers = {
            "standard": StandardScaler,
            "minmax": MinMaxScaler,
            "robust": RobustScaler,
            "maxabs": MaxAbsScaler,
        }
        return scalers.get(self.numeric_scaling, StandardScaler)()
    
    def _get_encoder(self):
        encoders = {
            "onehot": OneHotEncoder,
            "ordinal": OrdinalEncoder,
            "label": LabelEncoder,
        }
        return encoders.get(self.categorical_encoding, OneHotEncoder)(
            sparse_output=False,
            handle_unknown=self.handle_unknown
        )
    
    def _get_imputer(self, is_numeric: bool):
        if self.imputation_strategy == "knn":
            return KNNImputer(n_neighbors=self.imputation_neighbors)
        
        strategy = self.imputation_strategy if is_numeric else "most_frequent"
        return SimpleImputer(strategy=strategy)
    
    def execute(self, data: pd.DataFrame, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Separate numeric and categorical columns
        numeric_cols = data.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
        categorical_cols = data.select_dtypes(include=["object", "category"]).columns.tolist()
        
        processed_data = pd.DataFrame(index=data.index)
        
        # Process numeric columns
        if numeric_cols:
            # Imputation
            imputer = self._get_imputer(is_numeric=True)
            numeric_data = imputer.fit_transform(data[numeric_cols])
            self.transformers["numeric_imputer"] = imputer
            
            # Scaling
            scaler = self._get_scaler()
            numeric_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(numeric_data)
            self.transformers["numeric_scaler"] = scaler
            
            for i, col in enumerate(numeric_cols):
                processed_data[col] = numeric_scaled[:, i]
            
            self.feature_names["numeric"] = numeric_cols
        
        # Process categorical columns
        if categorical_cols:
            encoder = self._get_encoder()
            
            # Fill NaN values temporarily
            cat_data = data[categorical_cols].fillna("missing")
            
            if self.categorical_encoding == "label":
                # Label encoding is per-column
                for col in categorical_cols:
                    le = LabelEncoder()
                    processed_data[col] = le.fit_transform(cat_data[col])
                    self.transformers[f"label_encoder_{col}"] = le
            else:
                encoded = encoder.fit_transform(cat_data)
                self.transformers["categorical_encoder"] = encoder
                
                if self.categorical_encoding == "onehot":
                    feature_names = encoder.get_feature_names_out(categorical_cols)
                else:
                    feature_names = categorical_cols
                
                for i, name in enumerate(feature_names):
                    processed_data[name] = encoded[:, i]
                
                self.feature_names["categorical"] = list(feature_names)
        
        context["preprocessing"] = {
            "transformers": list(self.transformers.keys()),
            "feature_names": self.feature_names,
            "numeric_cols": numeric_cols,
            "categorical_cols": categorical_cols,
        }
        
        return processed_data


class FeatureSelectionStep(Step):
    """Feature selection for ML/DL models.
    
    Supports statistical tests, model-based selection, and recursive elimination.
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        method: str = "kbest",
        k: int = 10,
        score_func: str = "f_classif",
        model: Optional[Any] = None,
        threshold: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        self.method = method
        self.k = k
        self.score_func = score_func
        self.model = model
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.selector = None
        self.selected_features = []
    
    def _get_score_func(self):
        score_funcs = {
            "chi2": chi2,
            "f_classif": f_classif,
            "mutual_info": mutual_info_classif,
        }
        return score_funcs.get(self.score_func, f_classif)
    
    def execute(
        self,
        X: Union[pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray],
        y: Union[pd.Series, np.ndarray],
        context: Dict[str, Any]
    ) -> Union[pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray]:
        
        is_df = isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame)
        feature_names = X.columns if is_df else [f"feature_{i}" for i in range(X.shape[1])]
        
        if self.method == "kbest":
            self.selector = SelectKBest(
                score_func=self._get_score_func(),
                k=min(self.k, X.shape[1])
            )
            X_selected = self.selector.fit_transform(X, y)
            
        elif self.method == "model":
            if self.model is None:
                from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
                self.model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100)
            
            self.selector = SelectFromModel(
                estimator=self.model,
                threshold=self.threshold
            )
            X_selected = self.selector.fit_transform(X, y)
            
        elif self.method == "rfe":
            if self.model is None:
                from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
                self.model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
            
            self.selector = RFE(
                estimator=self.model,
                n_features_to_select=self.k
            )
            X_selected = self.selector.fit_transform(X, y)
        
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown method: {self.method}")
        
        # Track selected features
        if hasattr(self.selector, "get_support"):
            mask = self.selector.get_support()
            self.selected_features = [feature_names[i] for i in range(len(feature_names)) if mask[i]]
        
        context["feature_selection"] = {
            "method": self.method,
            "original_features": X.shape[1],
            "selected_features": X_selected.shape[1],
            "selected_feature_names": self.selected_features,
            "score_func": self.score_func if self.method == "kbest" else None,
        }
        
        if is_df:
            return pd.DataFrame(X_selected, columns=self.selected_features, index=X.index)
        return X_selected


class DataSplitterStep(Step):
    """Split data into train/validation/test sets.
    
    Supports stratified splits, time-based splits, and cross-validation.
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        train_size: float = 0.7,
        val_size: float = 0.15,
        test_size: float = 0.15,
        random_state: int = 42,
        stratify: bool = True,
        shuffle: bool = True,
        time_column: Optional[str] = None,
        cv_folds: Optional[int] = None,
        cv_strategy: str = "kfold",
    ):
        self.train_size = train_size
        self.val_size = val_size
        self.test_size = test_size
        self.random_state = random_state
        self.stratify = stratify
        self.shuffle = shuffle
        self.time_column = time_column
        self.cv_folds = cv_folds
        self.cv_strategy = cv_strategy
        self.splits = {}
    
    def execute(
        self,
        data: Union[pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray],
        target: Optional[Union[pd.Series, np.ndarray]] = None,
        context: Dict[str, Any] = None
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        
        context = context or {}
        is_df = isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame)
        
        # Handle time-based split
        if self.time_column:
            if not is_df:
                raise ValueError("Time-based split requires DataFrame")
            data = data.sort_values(self.time_column)
            n = len(data)
            train_end = int(n * self.train_size)
            val_end = train_end + int(n * self.val_size)
            
            train_data = data.iloc[:train_end]
            val_data = data.iloc[train_end:val_end]
            test_data = data.iloc[val_end:]
            
        elif self.cv_folds:
            # Cross-validation splits
            if self.cv_strategy == "stratified" and target is not None:
                splitter = StratifiedKFold(
                    n_splits=self.cv_folds,
                    shuffle=self.shuffle,
                    random_state=self.random_state
                )
            else:
                splitter = KFold(
                    n_splits=self.cv_folds,
                    shuffle=self.shuffle,
                    random_state=self.random_state
                )
            
            splits = []
            for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(splitter.split(data, target)):
                splits.append({
                    "fold": fold_idx,
                    "train_idx": train_idx,
                    "val_idx": val_idx,
                })
            
            context["cv_splits"] = splits
            return splits
        
        else:
            # Standard train/val/test split
            stratify_param = target if (self.stratify and target is not None) else None
            
            # First split: train vs remaining
            train_data, remaining_data, train_target, remaining_target = train_test_split(
                data, target,
                train_size=self.train_size,
                random_state=self.random_state,
                shuffle=self.shuffle,
                stratify=stratify_param
            )
            
            # Second split: val vs test
            val_ratio = self.val_size / (self.val_size + self.test_size)
            val_target = remaining_target
            
            if stratify_param is not None:
                val_stratify = remaining_target
            else:
                val_stratify = None
            
            val_data, test_data, val_target, test_target = train_test_split(
                remaining_data, remaining_target,
                train_size=val_ratio,
                random_state=self.random_state,
                shuffle=self.shuffle,
                stratify=val_stratify
            )
        
        result = {
            "train": train_data,
            "val": val_data,
            "test": test_data,
        }
        
        if target is not None:
            result["train_target"] = train_target
            result["val_target"] = val_target
            result["test_target"] = test_target if not self.time_column else remaining_target
        
        context["split_info"] = {
            "train_size": len(train_data),
            "val_size": len(val_data),
            "test_size": len(test_data),
            "stratify": self.stratify,
            "time_based": self.time_column is not None,
        }
        
        return result
